protocol.protocol: one warmup process per executable/control; ten paired repetitions with alternating executable order; no builds/profiling/correctness runs concurrently; preserve all raw samples

limitations: Performance deltas compare current PR production planner (2cfb2cdbe) against optimized planner dda12cd3b on one macOS arm64 host. Benchmark-only helper a9f16cde0 is identical before/after.
Planner refresh measurements exclude snapshot capture, serial admission/subscription/swaps and live economy. No live consumer is implemented.
Whole-engine study still retains original hiring. Completed-boundary material demand can disappear before capture. Do not extrapolate isolated planner speedup to live whole-match gains.
Headless run_ns includes 256 warmup ticks plus 256 measured ticks; CPU and tick percentiles describe only the measured window. No saves/checksum exports/diagnostic reports during timing.
Process wall/setup costs are not engine tick costs. Raw warmups, all outliers and complete commands retained.

Callgrind instruction counts are Linux arm64/GCC11.4 diagnostics, not native seconds. First complete rank per team excluded as warmup. Inclusive annotation has recursive/context artifacts and is not used for attribution; self counts and raw totals are retained.
macOS arm64 correctness only; no new Linux x86-64/Windows/browser matching traces, TSAN or gameplay footage. Linux arm64 used for profiling, not cross-platform simulation verification.
Host activity is uncontrolled. Profiling container stopped and builds/tests completed before timings; alternating order and paired confidence intervals reduce but do not eliminate host noise.
